svg.title: EcoRefill deployment diagram — UML style
svg.desc: Black-and-white UML deployment nodes with nested artifacts. Vercel hosts the web dashboards. The Android app on the phone uses Firebase for sign-in and records, and reaches the Raspberry Pi API through Cloudflare Tunnel. The Pi runs the kiosk, Flask, YOLO and hardware controls. It saves machine alerts to Firestore and sends owner notifications through Firebase Cloud Messaging to the Android app. Tapping a notification opens Alerts.
svg.text: Push notifications to the owner's Android app
